about:
Born in Oshkosh, WI, Abe grew up drawing. Starting with chalk and charcoal, he later expanded towards oil painting, which continues to be his favorite medium. He went to study art at UW Madison, graduating in 2026 with a B.S. in Art. Living in Madison for five years was one of the best experiences of his life. New friends, the UW Sailing team, and studying under the UW Art Department has influenced his art practice dramatically.

He has been a part of the Oshkosh Chalk walk five times, donated dozens of paintings to the UW Sailing team, and he was a Wisconsin Association of School Boards Student Art Exhibit award winner. He was a participant in The Memory Project, donating portraits to Afghanistan orphans. He has submitted work for the Paine Art Center and he has done a myriad of commissions for local business and other collectors. Abe continues to push his art practice towards more eyes, and is always looking for opportunities to get his work to the great number of those who appreciate it.

professionalBackground.specialties: Oil painting, chalk and charcoal drawing
